newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria airline flies again after November crash.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria airline flies again after November crash.

text.p: A Nigerian airline grounded after one of its planes crashed in November killing all 142 people aboard has resumed operations, company officials said on Thursday.
"Flights have started again to Abuja, but only two a day instead of at least four previously," said an official of the Aviation Development Company (ADC).
ADC, which has seven aircraft, was grounded two weeks after its Boeing 727 flying from the southeastern oil city of Port Harcourt crashed into a lagoon northeast of Lagos on November 7.
The independent Thisday newspaper on Thursday said ADC planned to bring in an Airbus A320 to fly the lucrative route from the Lagos commercial hub to the capital in Abuja.
The paper did not say whether ADC planned to lease or buy the Airbus, and company officials had no comment on the plan.
